def solve(case):
    nodes = {n['id']: n for n in case['nodes']}
    children = {}
    for n in case['nodes']:
        parent = n['parent']
        if parent is not None:
            children.setdefault(parent, []).append(n['id'])
    required = set(case['required_symbols'])
    removed = []  # order
    removed_set = set()
    sorted_ids = sorted(nodes.keys(), key=lambda x: (-nodes[x]['depth'], x))
    for node_id in sorted_ids:
        node = nodes[node_id]
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required:
            continue
        # check retained children
        node_children = children.get(node_id, [])
        if any(cid not in removed_set for cid in node_children):
            continue
        # Also, check if removing this node would remove a required symbol? Already.
        # remove
        removed.append(node_id)
        removed_set.add(node_id)
    retained = [nid for nid in nodes if nid not in removed_set]
    retained.sort()
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained}
